Select target_dictionary.tid AS target_tid, target_dictionary.pref_name AS target_name From activities Join assays On activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id Join target_dictionary On activities.tid = target_dictionary.tid Filter activities.standard_type = 'Ki' Filter activities.standard_relation = '=' Group By target_dictionary.tid target_dictionary.pref_name Sort By target_tid target_name
